verdict.rationale: The only sandbox-related evidence describes deploying app code to monday-managed isolated sandboxes. That is runtime and compute isolation for hosting. It is not a separate test environment or test account where an AI-native user can work without touching production board data. No dev or test workspace, sandbox account, or production-data separation is documented, so this is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Deploy to isolated sandboxes monday manages. Your syncs and tools run on our infra, not yours.
